dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, closed-loop and open-loop patterns with high-contrast, crenulated edges transitioning from dark exterior pixels to lighter interior pixels on the mid-lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized high density of small, solid light-gray to white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated on the anterior lateral neck and lower ventral-lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Spatial arrangement of centroids from the four most prominent lateral annuli form an irregular, non-convex quadrilateral on the mid-lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: High-visibility orange identification tag attached to the posterior-most extremity (hind flipper).
other_distinctive_markers: Synthetic red and black rectangular hardware with a white linear filament extending posteriorly, mounted on the mid-dorsal region.
